signin.title: Sign in to Phiegg
signin.sub: Your profile, your PFTs, your hosts.

steps.title: Pick your role
steps.body: Stylist, Collector, World builder or Front row.

steps.title: Say hi
steps.body: Your first message goes to #general in your host.

quests.title: Quests
quests.sub: Challenges across the 64 worlds. Rewards pay out in club coins.

play.title: Sponsored quests
play.sub: Quests sponsored by clubs. Play, win coin rewards, climb the front row.

coins.title: Coins
coins.sub: Every club has a coin. PHI is the platform coin.

pools.title: Pools
pools.sub: Every store line, club drop and fashion show is a pool: the centre of your PFTs. Live prices, stats, quests and swaps.

series.title: Watch
series.sub: Films from the 1940s to the 1960s, reality and fashion dramas, music and beauty series and plays: produced by clubs and streamed in their hosts.

league.title: Phiegg League SS26
league.sub: 64 clubs, knockout rounds. Each round is one metric, and every metric is a quest.

createKinds.label: Post a shot
createKinds.body: A picture or a look from your world, in the feed.

createKinds.label: Start a show
createKinds.body: A runway night: looks, poses and a host to talk to.

createKinds.label: Open a channel
createKinds.body: A room in a host for your club, your city or a topic.

createKinds.label: Mint a pool
createKinds.body: A collection of PFTs with its supply, floor and drop, linked to the clubs, cities and hosts it belongs to.

createKinds.label: List a ride
createKinds.body: A car, cab, van, jetski, saucer or fun ride, for sale or hire.

createKinds.body: Link a host, a PFT and an agent to a scenario and run it.
